meta.name: geniml
meta.description: This skill should be used when working with genomic interval data (BED files) for machine learning tasks. Use for training region embeddings (Region2Vec, BEDspace), single-cell ATAC-seq analysis (scEmbed), building consensus peaks (universes), or any ML-based analysis of genomic regions. Applies to BED file collections, scATAC-seq data, chromatin accessibility datasets, and region-based genomic feature learning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data with machine learning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if working with BED files or genomic region ML

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 BED 文件做基因组区间机器学习：训练区域嵌入（Region2Vec、BEDspace）、分析单细胞 ATAC-seq（scEmbed）、构建共识峰集（universe），以及进行聚类、相似性搜索等下游任务。
howto.when: 当你需要处理 BED 格式的基因组区间数据，进行机器学习分析时触发，例如训练区域嵌入、单细胞 ATAC-seq 分析或构建共识峰集。

say.text: 帮我用这些 BED 文件训练一个 Region2Vec 模型。
分析这个单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据，生成细胞嵌入并聚类。
从这些 BED 文件构建一个共识峰集（universe）。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you perform machine learning on genomic interval data from BED files: train region embeddings (Region2Vec, BEDspace), analyze single-cell ATAC-seq (scEmbed), build consensus peaks (universes), and perform clustering, similarity search, and other downstream tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to work with BED-format genomic interval data for machine learning tasks, such as training region embeddings, single-cell ATAC-seq analysis, or building consensus peaks.

say_en.text: Help me train a Region2Vec model using these BED files.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through tokenization and model training.

say_en.text: Analyze this single-cell ATAC-seq data, generate cell embeddings and cluster them.
say_en.note: Claude will use the scEmbed pipeline and integrate with scanpy for clustering.

say_en.text: Build a consensus peak set (universe) from these BED files.
say_en.note: Claude will use methods like coverage cutoff to generate the universe.
